title: CS India – Company Secretary Course
subtitle: Build Your Career in Corporate Law, Governance and Compliance

runs.text: The
Company Secretary (CS)
is a prestigious professional qualification offered by the
Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)
. It prepares students to become professionals in corporate law, company administration, regulatory compliance, corporate governance and business advisory services.

intro.text: The Company Secretary (CS) is a prestigious professional qualification offered by the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI). It prepares students to become professionals in corporate law, company administration, regulatory compliance, corporate governance and business advisory services.

runs.text: A Company Secretary plays an important role in ensuring that an organisation complies with applicable laws and regulations, follows good corporate governance practices and meets its statutory obligations.

intro.text: A Company Secretary plays an important role in ensuring that an organisation complies with applicable laws and regulations, follows good corporate governance practices and meets its statutory obligations.

runs.text: The CS qualification is an excellent choice for students interested in law, commerce, finance, business administration and corporate management.
